record_title: Uniform real-root barrier for fixed-parameter heavy-ball acceleration
limitations: The theorem concerns fixed nonnegative momentum and exact-gradient strongly convex quadratics, with worst-case asymptotic spectral radius taken uniformly over a continuous curvature interval. It does not imply that every accelerated finite matrix has an actual complex-root eigenmode, and it gives no finite-time monotonicity, nonlinear, stochastic, adaptive-parameter, Nesterov, or conjugate-gradient guarantee. Full theorem-level text of Torii-Hagan (2002) and Zhang (2015) was not inspected, leaving residual originality risk.
